title: [SOA] Setup can be saved while the agent remains inactive without warning
summary: The Sales Order Agent setup page now shows a confirmation when saving an inactive agent with configuration changes, asking whether to activate it. The first-time setup path was also fixed to actually activate the agent when the user confirms.
key_points: Confirmation appears only when the agent is inactive, setup changed, and the user didn't manually toggle Active
Confirmation is never shown for Try it out flow, manual Active toggle off, or when nothing changed
New ActivateAgent() helper ensures activation works correctly in both first-time setup and update flows
Previously, saying Yes to activate in first-time setup didn't work because FlowField overwrites were not handled
Only UI flow change, no schema or public API modifications
quote: The agent is configured but not active, so it won't process emails or tasks. Do you want to activate it now?
